adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members`, the diff introduces `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and then uses it directly in `group.users...limit(limit)` with no maximum cap. This means a caller can pass an arbitrarily large `limit` (e.g., very large integer) and cause the server to query/serialize a huge number of members in one response, potentially returning the entire membership list and creating a performance/DoS risk. The lack of an upper bound is verifiable from the new code.
